content: We implemented USVC and PitchNet using PyTorch BIBREF16 framework. Both models were trained on two Tesla P40 GPUs for four days. Adam optimizer BIBREF17 was used with a learning rate of $10^{-3}$ and a decay factor of 0.98 every 1000 steps. The batch size was set to 4 and finally the models were trained for 30k steps. $\lambda $ and $\mu $ in the training loss (DISPLAY_FORM8)(DISPLAY_FORM9) were set to $0.01$ and $0.1$ respectively. The dropout probability in the singer classification network and pitch regression network were both $0.2$.
